NVIDIA DLSS SDK, from NVIDIA/DLSS on GitHub (main, taken 2026-09-03).

None of NVIDIA's files are in this repository. The NVIDIA DLSS SDK licence permits distributing the SDK incorporated
into a built application, and forbids subjecting it to an open source licence (section 3.e) or distributing it as a
stand-alone product (section 3.b). tools\fetch-ngx.ps1 puts them here, and git ignores them:

  include\nvsdk_ngx*.h            the six headers build-host.ps1 compiles against
  lib\nvsdk_ngx_s.lib             the static-CRT import library build-host.ps1 links (4,740,514 bytes,
                                  MD5 16933B6EAA970224BCE203C8BE71B532)
  LICENSE-NVIDIA-DLSS-SDK.txt     NVIDIA's LICENSE.txt

"main" is not a pin. The hashes in tools\fetch-ngx.ps1 are: a fetch that returns other files is refused.

The DLSS runtime, nvngx_dlss.dll, is not needed to build. A player gets it with the mod from the Nexus page.
